title: Audio generation
subtitle: Connect speech, audio responses and music models in one configuration.
name: Configuration name

validation.summary: Review and correct the highlighted configuration fields.
validation.nameLength: The configuration name must not exceed 128 UTF-8 bytes.
validation.slotRequired: Configure at least one model slot.
validation.enabledSlotRequired: This configuration is enabled. Keep at least one model slot enabled.
validation.connectionKey: Enter a connection key of at most 64 UTF-8 bytes.
validation.connectionProtocol: Select a protocol for the model connection.
validation.baseURL: Enter an HTTP(S) service URL without credentials, query parameters or fragments, at most 512 bytes.
validation.apiKeyRequired: Enter an API key for this connection.
validation.apiKeyChangedURL: The service URL changed. Enter the API key again.
validation.apiKeyLength: The API key must not exceed 4096 bytes.
validation.connectionUnsupported: This connection protocol does not support this purpose. Select a compatible connection.
validation.modelLength: The model ID must not exceed 128 UTF-8 bytes.
validation.audioOutputRequired: Select a model that supports audio output.
validation.timeout: The timeout must be an integer from 1 to 86400 seconds.
validation.speakers: The speaker count must be an integer from 1 to {{max}}.
validation.paramsObject: Default parameters must be a valid JSON object, such as {}.
validation.paramsLength: Default parameters must not exceed 65536 bytes.
validation.descriptionLength: The tool description must not exceed 4096 UTF-8 bytes.

connectionHint: Set the protocol, URL and key for each channel. Bound model slots select their API automatically.
configHint: Bind a connection and select a model for each purpose. The connection selects the API automatically.
modelPlaceholder: Select or enter a model ID
discoveryHint: You can enter a model ID manually if discovery is unavailable.
defaultDescription: Leave blank for the built-in description
publishHint: After saving, enable the service, add it to a group, and bind the group to a client API key.
minimaxNotice: MiniMax restricts new users' Music API access. The connection URL must implement its standard music generation protocol.
testHint: Testing calls the upstream model and may incur charges. Accepted tasks continue in the background.
voicePlaceholder: Select or enter a voice ID
uploadFailed: Upload failed. Check the format and file size.
failed: Operation failed. Review the API error before retrying.
loadFailed: Could not load data. Refresh to retry.
historyHint: Results from web tests and MCP calls. Open details to play or download audio and view lyrics.
earliestExpires: Shows the earliest expiration among available audio files.
continues: Generation or saving continues in the background. Status updates automatically.
noMatchingTasks: No audio tasks match these filters.
selectPage: Select deletable tasks on this page
deleteTasksConfirm: Delete {{count}} selected tasks and their audio files?
deleteTaskConfirm: Delete this task and its audio files?
deleteConfigConfirm: Delete this configuration? History is kept and accepted tasks continue running.
noConfigsHint: Create a configuration and bind models to test or enable its MCP service.
retryHint: Generating again calls the upstream model and may incur charges. The task ID and creation time are preserved.
expiredRetry: Some inputs expired. Review the parameters and upload replacement media.

hint.speech: Read text or perform scripted dialogue with supported voices and delivery styles.
hint.audio: Generate spoken answers from text instructions or recordings.
hint.music: Create songs and soundtracks from descriptions, lyrics or supported images.

status.submission_unknown: Submission outcome unknown; do not resubmit
